---
name: Skill improvement
about: Suggest an improvement to an existing skill
labels: enhancement
---

## Affected skill
e.g., `clinical-paper-writing`.

## Type of improvement
- [ ] Factual correction (e.g., outdated reporting guideline reference)
- [ ] New anti-pattern to add
- [ ] New verification gate
- [ ] Clearer workflow structure
- [ ] New example to add
- [ ] Other (explain)

## Current behavior
What does the skill currently do (or fail to do)?

## Proposed change
What should it do instead? Be specific — quote the section if useful.

## Justification
Why is this change valuable? Citation, real-world example, or rationale.

## Would you contribute the change?
- [ ] Yes, I'll open a PR.
- [ ] No, suggesting only.
